mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (name, price, description, allergy_ingredients, photo_path, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{description}, #{allergyIngredients}, #{photoPath}, NOW());
INSERT INTO menu_list (menu_id, cocktail_id, status, registration_date) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{cocktailId}, #{status}, NOW());
INSERT INTO cocktails (cocktail_id, name, price, alcohol_content, recipe) VALUES (#{cocktailId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{alcoholContent}, #{recipe});
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.name, m.price, m.description, m.allergy_ingredients, m.photo_path, m.created_at, ml.registration_date, COALESCE(ml.status, '판매중') AS status, COALESCE(ml.cocktail_id, 0) AS cocktail_id FROM cocktail_bar_erp.menu m LEFT JOIN cocktail_bar_erp.menu_list ml ON m.menu_id = ml.menu_id WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT m.menu_id, m.name, m.price, m.description, m.allergy_ingredients, m.created_at, m.photo_path, COALESCE(ml.registration_date, m.created_at) AS registration_date, COALESCE(ml.status, '판매중') AS status, COALESCE(ml.cocktail_id, 0) AS cocktail_id FROM cocktail_bar_erp.menu m LEFT JOIN cocktail_bar_erp.menu_list ml ON m.menu_id = ml.menu_id ORDER BY m.menu_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_list WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
SELECT COALESCE(cocktail_id, 0) FROM menu_list WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, allergy_ingredients = #{allergyIngredients}, photo_path = #{photoPath} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId};
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(cocktail_id, 0) FROM menu_list WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
